args.title: Change default BOM option in CSV export
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The default value for the BOM option is currently set to true, causing the BOM character \ufeff to appear at the start of CSV exports. This change proposes making the default BOM option false or explicitly configurable to address the issue with BOM presence.

The file src/export/csv.ts contains the code setting the BOM option to true by default, causing the BOM character \ufeff to appear at the start of CSV exports. Changing this default or making it explicit directly addresses the issue about the BOM's presence in exports.
